name: 77006 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77006 (Houston) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77006 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77006 (Houston) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
